title: Owl Semaphore Badge System
description: Major release candidate for Owl Semaphore v2.0.0. Promotes the owl-only PNG lineage to the authoritative visual master and treats the human-selected gold branch / olive heritage marker as part of the source owl form before the V4 transforms (so it transforms with the owl rather than being a fixed decorative overlay). Adds the v2 asset doctrine (ASSET-DOCTRINE.md), AI-assisted-cleanup / Pixelmator Pro provenance disclosure (PROVENANCE.md), v2 asset doctrine tests (V4 alpha-geometry fidelity, palette correctness per state, NORMATIVE-not-red guardrail, CRITICAL-is-red guardrail, V4 algebra invariants, black-speckle / junk-pixel check), and a multi-page TIFF master assembler. The PDF pipeline is retargeted to the v2 asset set. The METACOGNITIVE phrasing introduced in v1.3.0-rc ('The observer audits the frame' / 'Thinking examines its own frame') is preserved. The Klein-four-group (V4) algebra and the sigma_h assignment to METACOGNITIVE are unchanged from v1.2.0. The four transforms form a finite subgroup of O(2) isomorphic to V4 (equivalently the dihedral group D2); the system is not O(2). No 31-degree tilt is doctrine. No formal verification claim is made. v2.0.0 has not yet been minted on Zenodo; the version DOI placeholder is TBD_BY_ZENODO_ON_RELEASE.
